ethnicity.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/6] For the husbands, 63.4% were Caucasian, 5.5% were African American, 14.5% were Latino, 8.9% were Asian American or Pacific Islander, 0.3% were Native American, 4.6% reported "Other," and 2.8% declined to answer. For the wives, 56.9% were Caucasian, 4.3% were African American, 16.0% were Latina, 14.7% were Asian American or Pacific Islander, 0.3% were Native American, 4.9% reported "Other," and 2.9% declined to answer.

lag.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/5] The first assessment was conducted 6–9 months prior to the couple's wedding date, the second assessment was conducted 6 months after the wedding date, the third assessment occurred 18 months after the wedding date.
